bio: Wise Equity is a Canadian home-equity strategy firm that helps homeowners use mortgage and HELOC structures, the Smith Manoeuvre, cash damming and private investing to build tax-efficient wealth and retirement income. The site claims 500+ families served, $100M+ in equity unlocked and service in three provinces, with an education-first, no-pressure approach and a free equity assessment. Brokerage and agent licences appear in the site header.
tagline: Turn Your Home Into an Asset for Tax-Free Income
serviceAreas: Canada (licensed across Canada; 3 provinces served per site)
